description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git reflog write' command. It contains test cases that validate input validation, object ID handling, reflog message normalization, writing to references, configuration precedence, environment variable overrides, and writing to root references.

methods.name: test_reflog_matches
methods.description: Validates that the reflog entries for a given reference match the expected contents by comparing the output after writing actual data.
